60dB 带宽与 6dB 带宽之比，≥1 且越小越好（1 为理想矩形）。晶体滤波: The ratio of the 60 dB bandwidth to the 6 dB bandwidth; ≥ 1 and the smaller the better (1 is an ideal rectangle). Crystal filters are typically 2:1–3:1, LC filters often above 4:1.
Q = f₀ / BW，中心频率与 3dB 带宽之比；Q 越高选择性越强、带宽越: Q = f₀ / BW, the ratio of centre frequency to 3 dB bandwidth; the higher the Q, the stronger the selectivity and the narrower the bandwidth.
中继台双工器需承受大功率且收发隔离度足够。: A repeater duplexer must withstand high power and provide adequate transmit/receive isolation.
信号通过滤波器后的功率损耗（dB），越小越好；多级级联会累加。: The power loss (dB) of a signal passing through the filter; the smaller the better, and it accumulates across cascaded stages.
发射低通滤波器按最高工作频段选择，抑制谐波干扰电视 / 电话。: Choose the transmit low-pass filter according to the highest operating band, to suppress harmonic interference to television / telephones.
只通过低频，抑制谐波，接在发射机输出端。: Passes only low frequencies and suppresses harmonics; connected at the transmitter output.
只通过某频段，竞赛多机工作时隔离收发。: Passes only one band; isolates receivers from transmitters when several rigs run together in a contest.
只通过高频，用于抑制低频干扰。: Passes only high frequencies; used to suppress low-frequency interference.
多机竞赛台用带通滤波器隔离，避免互相压制。: Multi-rig contest stations use band-pass filters for isolation so the rigs do not desensitise each other.
接收端陷波器可压制本地强广播干扰，改善信噪比。: A notch filter at the receiver can suppress strong local broadcast interference and improve the signal-to-noise ratio.
滚降最陡，但通带与阻带都有纹波，且阻带零点有限。: The steepest roll-off, but with ripple in both passband and stopband and only a finite number of stopband zeros.
滤除特定频率的强干扰，如广播干扰。: Removes strong interference at a specific frequency, such as broadcast interference.
窄带高选择性，用于收信机中频。: Narrow-band and highly selective; used in the receiver's IF stage.
线性相位、群时延平坦，瞬态响应好；幅频滚降最缓，适合脉冲类信号。: Linear phase and flat group delay with good transient response; the slowest amplitude roll-off, suited to pulse-type signals.
让收发共用一根天线，中继台核心器件。: Lets the transmitter and receiver share one antenna — the key component of a repeater.
通带内增益的起伏（dB），等纹波设计用它换取更陡的滚降。: The variation of gain within the passband (dB); equal-ripple designs trade it for a steeper roll-off.
通带内等纹波，换取更陡的滚降；纹波越大过渡带越窄。: Equal ripple in the passband, traded for a steeper roll-off; the larger the ripple, the narrower the transition band.
通带最平坦、无纹波，滚降较缓；适合对通带平坦度要求高的场合。: Flattest passband with no ripple and a gentle roll-off; suited where passband flatness matters most.
